Here’s what the adults are doing about healthcare:

1) Expand access to health savings accounts (HSAs) for all Americans. Money should go to the patient, not insurance companies.

2) Price transparency - you need to know prices for a market to work.

3) Cost share reduction - we could actually both lower cost sharing and premiums. Democrats fought to get this provision out of the Big Beautiful Bill.

I fought to add Direct Primary Care to the list of qualified expenses that can be paid for with a HSA in the Working Families Tax Cut. 

Insurance coverage and access to care are not the same thing. HSAs bridge that gap.
